title: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut to adjust your storyline with timestamp-level…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut to adjust your storyline with timestamp-level precision directly on the timeline  
Use up to 50 reference images in Seedance 2.5 to guide the generated video’s look and continuity  
Generate longer-form outputs by setting Seedance 2.5 to create videos up to 90 seconds  
Use viewport rendering in CapCut with Seedance 2.5 to preview/render within the workspace during iteration  
Use a green screen workflow in CapCut with Seedance 2.5 to composite subjects/backgrounds without leaving the platform

ja.content:

Seedance 2.5에서 최대 50장의 레퍼런스 이미지를 사용해 생성된 영상의 비주얼과 연속성을 가이드하세요
